info.description: Orders, payments and deliveries are command resources: they are created with POST (201) and changed only through actions, POST /{id}/<action> (202), each returning {id, version}. **Reads are eventually consistent:** right after a command a GET may still return the old version, or 404 after a create; read until `version` reaches the command's version. Persons, addresses and items are plain CRUD resources.
